title: Cart review
idea: Cart review: Editable items and fulfillment constraints lead directly into a complete, clearly scoped total.
audience: People who need to review cart within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: People need to correct items and understand the commitment.
avoidWhen: Costs or fulfillment conditions are hidden until the last action.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic transaction layout through its review cart priority and explicit commitment contract: Do not mark payment complete from a redirect or optimistic client state.
navigation: Cart review keeps the current review cart context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Editable items and fulfillment constraints lead directly into a complete, clearly scoped total.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review cart; people need to correct items and understand the commitment.
composition.priority: Do not mark payment complete from a redirect or optimistic client state.

imagery.role: Support the actual review cart context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Stack item review before totals and keep destructive removal recoverable.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the cart review structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review cart content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Do not mark payment complete from a redirect or optimistic client state.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review cart content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Do not mark payment complete from a redirect or optimistic client state.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review cart context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
